name: UK Tenders (Remote)
description: Connects to the hosted UK Tenders MCP endpoint: live UK public-sector tender and contract notices from Contracts Finder (Open Government Licence) by keyword, region, or CPV code. tenders_discover is a free peek at up to 5 open notices; tenders_pack (full notice list) and tender_score_pack (notices with per-notice fit scores and risk flags) each return a one-time £0.49 Stripe Checkout link.
